name: Zombie Surge

text.fail: A surge of the dead hits: six at the colony and one at every other location. No morale is lost.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Official name Zombie Surge (was our Zombie Wave). English card photo (bing, pinterest) prints Tool and 6 zombies at the colony plus 1 at every other location, settling conflict C2 (the 8 on the fan sheet was a copy slip). Id kept for saves.
